changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: pull_request_review stored its provider timestamps without a time zone, unlike every other application column. The stored values are UTC wall-clock times, so the conversion reads them as UTC.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE pull_request_review ALTER COLUMN created_at TYPE timestamp(6) with time zone USING created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', ALTER COLUMN updated_at TYPE timestamp(6) with time zone USING updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE pull_request_review ALTER COLUMN created_at TYPE timestamp(6) without time zone USING created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', ALTER COLUMN updated_at TYPE timestamp(6) without time zone USING updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: A delete or update of the row that auth_event.acting_account_id references scans every auth_event partition without this index. PostgreSQL cannot build an index on a partitioned table concurrently, and auth_event is small, so this one locks writes briefly. New partitions inherit it.
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_auth_event_acting_account_id ON auth_event (acting_account_id)
